title: 第5章 挑拨
content_zh:
“姑娘，二姑娘来看你了。”
惊蛰面色有些不虞：“偏在这个时候来，姑娘身子还没好，也不怕惊了风寒。”
谷雨推了推惊蛰的胳膊，神情却也十分忧虑。
沈妙看在眼里，心中舒了口气。
她身边四个丫头，都是沈信和沈夫人亲自挑选调教的人，忠心机灵都有。沈家究竟是个什么状况，二房和三房暗藏的心思，她年纪小看不出来，丫头却能瞧出端倪。
还没来得及说话，便见外头走来一名少女。这少女不过十五六岁的模样，穿了一件淡粉色菊纹上裳，月白百褶如意裙，梳着个流苏髻。肤色白皙，眉目清雅秀美，浑身都是浓浓的书卷味，显得得体而端庄。瞧见她，便快步走到床前，担忧道：“五妹妹，身子可觉得好些了？知道你落水后，我心焦了许久，可玉娇苑的人说你要休息，我不敢打扰，今儿听你醒了方敢过来。”
沈妙看着面前的少女，这是沈家三房所出的嫡女沈玥。
沈家出的三个嫡女，沈清开朗大气，沈玥才名远播，偏只有沈妙，性格木讷，怯懦无才，外人夸赞“贞静贤淑”，其实都知道并无长处，是沈家最上不得台面的女儿。
上辈子，沈妙未出嫁前，和沈玥的关系最好。沈玥性情温柔体贴，许多时候都能帮沈妙出主意。只是当初沈妙并不能看出这其中的主意究竟是好是坏，还是一味感激这位堂姐尽心尽力的帮忙。
这一次沈玥前来，大约也是为沈清求情。

果然，沈玥开口就是：“五妹妹，大姐当日也是失手犯错，事已至此，还望五妹妹能原谅她一回。听闻五妹妹发热，大姐也是自责的不得了。五妹妹伤好后，可否饶过大姐姐这一回？她也不是故意让你在定王殿下面前出丑的。”
不说这话还好，偏要在沈妙面前提起定王二字。谁都知道定王就是沈妙的心尖子，沈妙是能吃的委屈的性子，但有关定王，定不会退让半分。若不提定王，说不定沈妙便这么罢了，此番沈玥故意提起定完，不是要挑起她和沈清的争端是什么？
上辈子也是这样，她刚刚醒来不就，沈玥就赶来为沈清“求情”，这一番求情，令沈妙勃然大怒。平日里性格诺诺的人，为了心上人，当着老夫人的面指责沈清将她推下水。偏沈清不承认，周围的人也说没瞧见沈清推沈玥，老夫人本就偏袒二三房，自然顺势教训她“小小年纪不知自爱，还妄图污蔑嫡姐”，罚她禁足。
后来这事便被传到国子监去了，沈妙成为同学的笑柄，羞愤之下，国子监也不去了。再后来……京城中的贵女圈，她也渐渐淡了出去。
如今想来，她的目光，一直都被局限在将军府这些人为她创造的世界中，她以为自己贤良淑德，殊不知外人眼中是懦弱无知，以为爱慕定王是勇敢直率，殊不知外人称她不知廉耻。
这些刻意教导的结果，导致了她前期一塌糊涂的印象。虽然后来成功嫁给傅修宜，却仍然被称为上不得台面，甚至天下人拿她和楣夫人比较，也只会说她蠢笨无知。
多蠢的过去呵！
沈玥忧虑的抚着沈妙的肩头，唇角不动声色的露出一丝笑意。
她知道以沈妙的性子，只要提到傅修宜，定会勃然大怒。可等了半天也不见反应，沈玥狐疑的看过去，便见面前的少女微笑着看着她。

少女脸色还很苍白，嘴唇也干涩，唯有一双黑漆漆的眼睛葡萄一般的水灵。
沈妙的眼睛长得最好看，大大的杏眼，懵懵懂懂，像甫出生的小狗一般怯怯的。只是平日里神情木讷，平白辜负了眼睛的灵气。
如今那双杏眼依旧圆圆，眼神却十分不一样。透着些冷意，不带感情，不像是木讷，倒像是……倒像是居高临下的俯视。
沈玥一个激灵，不知道为什么，心中竟敢生出了一种无法言喻的胆颤。好像面对的不是一个蠢笨的呆头鹅，而是什么身居高位的人。
怎么会有这样的感觉？
她自然不知道，面前的沈妙，已经不是那个沈妙了。面前的沈妙，是经历了夺嫡，战乱，争宠，丧子，亡族的沈妙。
是曾执掌后宫，拥有六宫至高无上权力的，明齐皇后沈皇后。
她愣了半晌，直到面前的少女揉了揉额头，轻声道：“二姐姐言重了，此事本就与大姐姐无关，是我自个儿掉下去的。”
“五妹妹……”沈玥没料到沈妙会这么说，呆了一下才反应过来，摇头道：“五妹妹莫要委屈自己。”
“我哪里会委屈自己呢，”沈妙笑着打断了她的话：“不过是小事罢了，我头还有些晕，想再休息会儿，有什么事情，明日在祖母那一并说吧。”
话都说到这个份上，沈玥也不好再说什么了。她虽然奇怪今日沈妙待她不甚热络，也归结于沈妙在傅修宜面前出丑，所以心情不悦。又说了几句，沈玥这才离开。
等沈玥走后，谷雨才道：“咱们姑娘被推下水，命差点没了，偏来替大姑娘求情，求情就求情吧，怎么听着不是那回事儿。”谷雨是在隐晦的提醒沈妙，沈玥不安好心。
“鹬蚌相争渔翁得利，她大约是想当那个‘渔翁’吧。”沈妙淡淡道。
谷雨惊喜沈妙终于能看清沈玥的真面目，又有些不明白沈妙话里的意思，抬头见自家姑娘讨喜的容颜一片冰寒，竟有种莫名的肃然感，让人不由自主的仰视。
沈妙看着自己的指尖。
沈清为什么会推她下水？是因为当时她说了一句：“年关等爹凯旋，我便让爹做主，求爹将我嫁给定王殿下。”
她说的天真，又觉得是自家人，因此毫无顾忌。沈信是朝中大将，有心要嫁女儿，不是不可能的。
沈玥为什么要挑拨她和沈清？
自然是因为，沈玥也爱慕定王。
上辈子死到临头，沈玥和沈清才告诉她，她二人爱慕傅修宜许久。如今想来，这时候就已经初见端倪了。

既然她们这两姐妹都对傅修宜痴心一片，今生不让她们得偿所愿，岂不是可惜？
她一定会让她们心想事成，二房和三房上辈子欠沈家满门的血债，就从现在开始偿还吧。
content_en:
"Girl, the second girl is here to see you."
Jingzhe looked a little worried: "I came at this time, the girl is not well yet, and I am not afraid of being frightened by the cold."
Gu Yu pushed Jingzhe's arm, but his expression was also very worried.
Shen Miao saw this and felt relieved in her heart.
The four girls around her were all personally selected and trained by Shen Xin and Mrs. Shen, and they were loyal and clever. What is the situation of the Shen family, and the hidden thoughts of the second and third bedrooms, she is too young to see, but the girl can see the clues.
Before he could speak, he saw a girl walking outside. The girl looked to be only fifteen or sixteen years old. She wore a light pink chrysanthemum patterned top, a moon-white pleated Ruyi skirt, and a fringed bun. She has a fair complexion, elegant and beautiful eyebrows, and a strong smell of books all over her body, making her look decent and dignified. Seeing her, he quickly walked to the bed and said worriedly: "Fifth sister, are you feeling better? I was anxious for a long time after I found out you fell into the water, but the people in Yujiao Garden said you wanted to rest, so I didn't dare to disturb you. I didn't dare to come here until I heard you wake up."
Shen Miao looked at the girl in front of her, she was Shen Yue, the legitimate daughter of the third room of the Shen family.
Of the three legitimate daughters of the Shen family, Shen Qing was cheerful and cheerful, Shen Yue was famous for her talents, but only Shen Miao was dull, timid and untalented. Outsiders praised her as "quiet, quiet and virtuous", but in fact everyone knew that she had no merit and was the most unattractive daughter of the Shen family.
In her previous life, before Shen Miao got married, Shen Miao had the best relationship with Shen Yue. Shen Yue has a gentle and considerate temperament and can often help Shen Miao with ideas. It was just that at the beginning Shen Miao could not see whether the idea was good or bad, but she was always grateful to this cousin for her wholehearted help.
This time Shen Yue came here to plead for Shen Qing.
(adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
Sure enough, Shen Yue said: "Fifth sister, the eldest sister also made a mistake that day. Now that the matter has come to this, I hope the fifth sister can forgive her for once. Hearing that the fifth sister has a fever, the eldest sister is also blaming herself. After the fifth sister recovers from her injury, can you spare the eldest sister this time? She didn't mean to make you look embarrassed in front of His Highness Prince Ding."
It would have been better not to say this, but he wanted to mention the word "Ding Wang" in front of Shen Miao. Everyone knew that Prince Ding was Shen Miao's best friend and Shen Miao had a temper that could tolerate grievances, but regarding Prince Ding, Shen Miao would not give in even an inch. If King Ding was not mentioned, maybe Shen Miao would just do it. This time, Shen Yue deliberately brought up Ding Wan. Wasn't it to provoke a dispute between her and Shen Qing?
It was the same in her previous life. As soon as she woke up, Shen Yue came to "please" for Shen Qing. This plea made Shen Miao furious. A person who usually has a peaceful personality, for the sake of his sweetheart, accused Shen Qing of pushing her into the water in front of the old lady. Shen Qing refused to admit it, and people around her said they didn't see Shen Qing pushing Shen Yue. The old lady was already partial to the second and third bedrooms, so she naturally taught her "You don't know how to love yourself at a young age, and you try to slander your eldest sister" and punished her with a grounding.
Later, this matter was reported to the Imperial College, and Shen Miao became the laughing stock of her classmates. She was so embarrassed and angry that she did not go to the Imperial College. Later...she gradually faded out of the circle of noble ladies in the capital.
Thinking about it now, her vision has always been limited to the world created for her by the people in the General's Mansion. She thought she was virtuous and virtuous, but she didn't know that in the eyes of outsiders, she was weak and ignorant. She thought that her love for Prince Ding meant she was brave and straightforward, but she didn't know that outsiders called her shameless.
The result of these deliberate teachings led to her early impression of being in a mess. Although she later successfully married Fu Xiu Yi, she was still considered unattractive. Even when people in the world compared her to Mrs. Mei, they would only call her stupid and ignorant.
What a stupid past!
Shen Yue caressed Shen Miao's shoulder worriedly, with a smile on her lips.
She knew that with Shen Miao's temperament, whenever she mentioned Fu Xiu Yi, she would definitely become furious.. But after waiting for a long time, there was no response. Shen Yue looked over suspiciously and saw the girl in front of her smiling at her.
The girl's face was still very pale, her lips were dry, and she only had a pair of dark, grape-like eyes.
Shen Miao had the most beautiful eyes, big almond eyes, ignorant and timid like a newborn puppy. It's just that his expression is dull on weekdays, which fails to live up to the aura of his eyes.
Nowadays, those almond eyes are still round, but their expression is very different. There was a bit of coldness and no emotion. It didn't seem dull, but... it seemed like he was looking down from above.
Shen Yue was shocked. She didn't know why, but she felt an indescribable fear in her heart. It seemed that he was not facing a stupid goose, but someone in a high position.
How come you feel like this?
She naturally did not know that the Shen Miao in front of her was no longer the same Shen Miao. The Shen Miao in front of him was Shen Miao who had gone through the struggle for heirs, wars, fights for favor, the loss of a son, and the death of his family.
It was Empress Shen, the Empress of Ming Qi, who had been in charge of the harem and had the supreme power of the Sixth Palace.
She was stunned for a long time, until the girl in front of her rubbed her forehead and said softly: "Second sister said something harsh. This matter has nothing to do with eldest sister. It was me who fell down."
"Fifth sister..." Shen Yue did not expect Shen Miao to say this. She was stunned for a moment before she realized what she was saying. She shook her head and said, "Fifth sister, please don't wrong yourself."
"How could I wrong myself?" Shen Miao interrupted her with a smile: "It's just a small matter. I'm still a little dizzy. I want to rest for a while. If there is anything else, let's talk to my grandmother tomorrow."
After talking about it for this reason, Shen Yue couldn't say anything more. Although she was surprised that Shen Miao was not very warm to her today, it was also attributed to the fact that Shen Miao had made a fool of herself in front of Fu Xiu Yi, so she was unhappy. After saying a few more words, Shen Yue left.
After Shen Yue left, Gu Yu said: "Our girl was pushed into the water and almost died, so she came to plead for the eldest girl. Please just plead for mercy. It doesn't sound like that." Gu Yu was vaguely reminding Shen Miao that Shen Yue had no good intentions.
"The snipe and the clam are competing for the fisherman's profit. She probably wants to be the 'fisherman'." Shen Miao said lightly.
Guyu was pleasantly surprised that Shen Miao could finally see Shen Yue's true face, but he also did not understand the meaning of Shen Miao's words. He looked up and saw that his girl's lovely face was icy cold. There was an inexplicable sense of solemnity that made people look up involuntarily.
Shen Miao looked at her fingertips.
Why did Shen Qing push her into the water? It was because she said at that time: "When my father returns home at the end of the year, I will let him make the decision and ask him to marry me to His Highness Prince Ding."
She spoke innocently and felt that she was one of her own family members, so she had no scruples. Shen Xin was a general in the court, so it was not impossible for him to want to marry his daughter.
Why did Shen Yue want to provoke a fight between her and Shen Qing?
Naturally, it was because Shen Yue also loved Prince Ding.
When she was about to die in her previous life, Shen Yue and Shen Qing told her that they had loved Fu Xiu Yi for a long time. Now that I think about it, the clues have already begun to appear at this time.
Since these two sisters are obsessed with Fu Xiu Yi, wouldn't it be a pity not to let them get what they want in this life?
She will definitely make their wishes come true. The second and third bedrooms owe the Shen family a blood debt in their previous lives, and they should repay it from now on.
